purpose: Production-readiness audit for the completed Dallas realistic 3D chibi specification and Gamecast contracts before Dallas is allowed to advance toward final completion.

qualityGates.requirement: Every production player identity and action inventory resolves through DAL/roster.json; no superseded or non-active player may become Gamecast-eligible merely because an asset folder exists.
All 53 appearance locks must be tied to a current official headshot/reference. Skin tone, hair, facial hair and other visible traits must never be inferred from a name.
Player number and Dallas uniform identity must match the roster snapshot and remain readable without mirroring in every authored orientation.
All production assets retain the approved realistic 3D chibi proportions, camera family, lighting family, scale and transparent-background treatment.
Idle, action and celebration sequences preserve the canonical foot anchor and do not visibly jump when Gamecast changes clips.
Each player's production action set is position-appropriate and is a subset of the authoritative action inventory in roster.json.
Production renders must have true transparent backgrounds with clean silhouette edges and no baked stadium, matte fringe or opaque canvas.
Action and sequence names use the canonical Gamecast naming vocabulary and resolve deterministically across base, action and celebration assets.
Gamecast choreography permits exactly one authoritative football owner/flight state at a time and reconciles corrections without duplicate balls.
Repeated live polling cannot restart an already-consumed animation or signature celebration for the same authoritative play revision.
Missing, undecodable or ineligible chibi assets degrade to an eligible generic/action asset or the existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation without affecting live game truth.
Dallas/NFL chibi state, cache keys, telemetry and fallbacks are namespaced so MLB and NHL behavior cannot be changed by this library.

signatureAudit.qa: Named signature is permitted only for the historically recognized nose-wipe first-down concept already approved for this project; ordinary first downs may fall back safely when the signature asset is unavailable.
Named signature is permitted only for the recognized DeSoto Shuffle concept already approved for this project; sack truth must not depend on celebration playback.

acceptanceFixtures.assert: Authoritative Dallas snapshot contains exactly 53 active-53 player records before release eligibility is granted.
Each authoritative active-53 slug has a player production namespace and no missing player may be silently substituted with another player's identity.
All 53 players have an official-current-headshot appearance reference lock before their personalized base chibi can pass QA.
A render whose jersey number disagrees with the authoritative roster record is rejected rather than displayed as that player.
An action absent from the player's roster.json inventory cannot become eligible through an archetype superset.
Idle-to-action-to-celebration transitions preserve the canonical ground/foot anchor within the production tolerance.
Opaque-background or visible matte-fringe renders fail release eligibility.
A qualifying CeeDee Lamb first down may route to nose-wipe once for the authoritative play revision; repeated polling cannot replay it.
A qualifying Von Miller sack may route to desoto-shuffle once for the authoritative play revision; the sack remains correct if the celebration asset fails.
No other named player-specific signature is accepted without verified source metadata.
An authoritative play correction invalidates stale animation ownership, football state and signature-consumption state before reconstruction.
NFL Dallas chibi QA/release state cannot mutate MLB or NHL runtime namespaces, assets, caches or presentation.
